an5.73:1.1: athakho aññataro bhikkhu yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
an5.73:1.3: kittāvatā nukho bhante bhikkhu dhammavihārī hotīti.
an5.73:2.2: suttaṃ geyyaṃ veyyākaraṇaṃ gāthaṃ udānaṃ itivuttakaṃ jātakaṃ abbhutadhammaṃ vedallaṃ
an5.73:2.3: so tāya dhammapariyattiyā divasaṃ atināmeti riñcati paṭisallānaṃ nānuyuñjati ajjhattaṃ cetosamathaṃ
an5.73:2.4: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhu pariyattibahulo no dhammavihārī.
an5.73:3.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhu yathāsutaṃ yathāpariyattaṃ dhammaṃ vitthārena paresaṃ deseti
an5.73:3.2: so tāya dhammapaññattiyā divasaṃ atināmeti riñcati paṭisallānaṃ nānuyuñjati ajjhattaṃ cetosamathaṃ
an5.73:3.3: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhu paññattibahulo no dhammavihārī.
an5.73:4.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhu yathāsutaṃ yathāpariyattaṃ dhammaṃ vitthārena sajjhāyaṃ karoti
an5.73:4.2: so tena sajjhāyena divasaṃ atināmeti riñcati paṭisallānaṃ nānuyuñjati ajjhattaṃ cetosamathaṃ
an5.73:4.3: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhu sajjhāyabahulo no dhammavahārī.
an5.73:5.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhu yathāsutaṃ yathāpariyattaṃ dhammaṃ cetasā anuvitakketi anuvicāreti manasānupekkhati
an5.73:5.2: so tehi dhammavitakkehi divasaṃ atināmeti riñcati paṭisallānaṃ nānuyuñjati ajjhattaṃ cetosamathaṃ
an5.73:5.3: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhu vitakkabahulo no dhammavihārī.
an5.73:6.2: suttaṃ geyyaṃ veyyākaraṇaṃ gāthaṃ udānaṃ itivuttakaṃ jātakaṃ abbhutadhammaṃ vedallaṃ
an5.73:6.3: so tāya dhammapariyattiyā na divasaṃ atināmeti na riñcati paṭisallānaṃ anuyuñjati ajjhattaṃ cetosamathaṃ
an5.73:7.1: iti kho bhikkhu desito mayā pariyattibahulo desito paññattibahulo desito sajjhāyabahulo desito vitakkabahulo desito dhammavihārī
an5.73:7.2: yaṃ bhikkhu satthārā karaṇīyaṃ sāvakānaṃ hitesinā anukampakena anukampaṃ upādāya kataṃ vo taṃ mayā
an5.73:7.3: etāni bhikkhu rukkhamūlāni etāni suññāgārāni jhāyatha bhikkhu mā pamādattha mā pacchā vippaṭisārino ahuvattha ayaṃ vo amhākaṃ anusāsanīti.
